/about.metadata.title: About · Ratoeira77
/about.metadata.description: About Ratoeira77 and the story behind the store.
/about.section.title: About me
/about.section.body: Ratoeira77 is the creative studio behind a curated collection of art and lifestyle pieces. Known for ethereal light and vivid color, the work blends natural and otherworldly elements. Themes include connection, renewal, and exploration of the imagination. The creative output often originates from spontaneous visions and exploratory processes. You can usually find the studio participating in local markets and events. The team also offers commissioned work, murals, and live painting at private events and festivals.

/faq.metadata.title: FAQ · Ratoeira77
/faq.metadata.description: Frequently asked questions about purchases, commissions, and support.
/faq.page.title: Frequently asked questions
/faq.page.items.payment.question: Which payment methods does the store accept?
/faq.page.items.payment.answer: Payments are processed by Stripe and can include cards and compatible wallets shown during checkout.
/faq.page.items.tracking.question: How do I track my order?
/faq.page.items.tracking.answer: Whenever the status changes, the store may send updates by email according to the information registered in your account.
/faq.page.items.customWork.question: Does Ratoeira77 take commissions?
/faq.page.items.customWork.answer: Yes. Depending on the product or project, production timelines and alignment may be required before shipping.
/faq.page.items.contact.question: How do I get in touch about events, art, or special projects?
/faq.page.items.contact.answer: Use the contact page or the brand's official channels to talk about murals, activations, and commissions.
/privacy.metadata.title: Privacy · Ratoeira77
/privacy.page.title: Privacy
/privacy.page.intro: This page summarizes how Ratoeira77 handles data submitted by customers through registrations, forms, and orders.
/privacy.page.sections.collectedData.bod: We may store information provided during checkout, login, and contact forms to process purchases, respond to requests, and track orders.
Data may be used for support, payment confirmation, order communication, fraud prevention, and store experience improvements.
/privacy.page.sections.contact.title: 3. Contact
/privacy.page.sections.contact.body: For any privacy-related questions, use the contact page or the official Ratoeira77 channels.
/terms.metadata.title: Terms · Ratoeira77
/terms.page.title: Terms of use
/terms.page.intro: By browsing, purchasing, or requesting support from Ratoeira77, you agree to the general terms of this store.
/terms.page.sections.storeUse.title: 1. Store use
/terms.page.sections.storeUse.body: Use of the store must comply with applicable law and the purchase, support, and delivery rules published on the official pages.
/terms.page.sections.orders.title: 2. Orders and support
/terms.page.sections.orders.body: Orders are subject to payment confirmation, stock availability, production timelines, and any necessary alignment with the customer.
/terms.page.sections.updates.title: 3. Updates
/terms.page.sections.updates.body: These terms may be updated at any time and become effective once published.
/terms.page.sections.contact.title: 4. Contact
/terms.page.sections.contact.body: If you have questions, use the contact page to reach Ratoeira77.
